create_Emg2PoseSessionData: create an Emg2PoseSessionData instance to read EMG timeseries data from an HDF5 session file
slice_Emg2PoseSessionData: slice an Emg2PoseSessionData timeseries by start and end timestamps to extract a window of EMG samples
access_Emg2PoseSessionData_metadata: access session metadata like session name, user ID, and sample rate from an Emg2PoseSessionData instance
create_WindowedEmgDataset: create a WindowedEmgDataset PyTorch dataset with configurable window length, stride, and padding for EMG data
get_WindowedEmgDataset_item: get a windowed EMG sample with joint angles and IK failure mask from a WindowedEmgDataset by index
